title: Bread and Ovens
summary: Bread was a basic food of daily life and was commonly prepared in homes, villages, and camps.
background: Grain had to be ground, kneaded, baked, and shared. Bread often appears as a sign of provision, hospitality, fellowship, and dependence on God.
teachingHelp: When Scripture mentions bread, ask whether the passage is emphasizing daily provision, fellowship, sacrifice, temptation, or Christ as true bread.
